data.name: Nitin
data.gender_notes: Nitin is used as a male name in hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Sanskrit nīti, 'moral conduct, policy' — nitin, 'one of moral conduct'. Its root is Sanskrit nīti (नीति). A classical Sanskrit name. Nitin is a Sanskrit name meaning “Moral; righteous; guided”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
data.spiritual_meaning: Nitin expresses “Moral; righteous; guided”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.etymology: From the Sanskrit nīti, 'moral conduct, policy' — nitin, 'one of moral conduct'.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Nitin total 30, reducing to 3. Number 3 is associated with expression, creativity and optimism.

vedic_reference.note: Nitin is a name found in Hindu mythology, specifically in the Mahabharata. It is the name of a sage and a charioteer of Arjuna. The name is derived from the Sanskrit word 'nit' which means 'truth' or 'established in truth'. Nitin is also considered a form of the god Vishnu.
